svg.title: Lettering before and after — DRAFT
svg.desc: DRAFT — NOT FOR PUBLICATION. Original Instrument Sans 470 glyph contours; shaped and optically spaced. No font binary, glyph shape, type family or final brand approval is changed.
svg.text: Same family, weight and glyph contours. The refinement is spacing and arrangement.
110-unit pitch; more space at rn / cl, slight Ta / Pr easing.
Full name stays on one baseline for wide headers and signs; no words are reduced.
Two-line name at a normal small-use width
Font-based optical refinement. No custom-drawn glyphs, modified font binaries or final type approval.
